claims.text: The winning technology startup of the last twenty years was usually built by a clever, ambitious outsider who found a gap, raised on belief and hired the experts.
claims.quote: Someone very clever and very ambitious finds a gap in a market.

claims.text: In execution these startups displaced incumbents that had the customers, the environment, the domain knowledge and sometimes the money, but lacked structure, workflows and technology culture.
claims.quote: these startups displaced a large number of incumbents who had a much better starting position

claims.text: In Horsley Bridge's data on about 7,000 venture investments, 6% of deals produced at least a 10x return and made up 60% of total returns.
claims.quote: 6% of deals produced at least a 10x return, and those made up 60% of total returns.

value.unit: percent of deals that made 60% of returns

claims.text: Christensen found that the firms leading in disruptive technologies were entrants to the industry, not its incumbent leaders.
claims.quote: were entrants to the industry, not its incumbent leaders.

claims.text: When experts reviewed 77 of the cases Christensen and Raynor used, only 7 fitted the theory in full.
claims.quote: only 7 fitted the theory in full

value.unit: cases fitting the theory of disruption in full

claims.text: Adrian Cockcroft told a Fortune 100 CTO that Netflix hired its superstar developers from him and got out of their way; the talent was already inside the incumbents.
claims.quote: Netflix hired them from you, and got out of their way.

claims.text: The disruptors became the incumbents: Wardley wrote in 2016 that the new entrants are rapidly becoming the new titans.
claims.quote: The new entrants are rapidly becoming the new titans

claims.text: After a diversifying merger the novelty of the acquired company's research falls by about 60%, and older firms produce technology of lower quality.
claims.quote: the novelty of the acquired company's research falls by about 60%

value.unit: percent fall in research novelty after a diversifying merger

claims.text: Workers in three Fortune 500 companies toggled between applications roughly 1,200 times each day.
claims.quote: roughly 1,200 times each day

value.unit: application toggles per worker per day

claims.text: Organisations juggle an average of 83 security solutions from 29 vendors, and 84% of CISOs say they have been blindsided by incidents their tools should have prevented.
claims.quote: an average of 83 different security solutions from 29 vendors

value.unit: security solutions per organisation, from 29 vendors

claims.text: Generative AI changes who can start: when agents do most of the execution, the people who know the problem can build the product themselves without the millions that used to come first.
claims.quote: My argument is that generative AI changes who can start.

claims.text: Carta reports the share of new US startups with a solo founder rose from 23.7% in 2019 to 36.3% in the first half of 2025.
claims.quote: the share of new US startups with a solo founder rose from 23.7% in 2019 to 36.3% in the first half of 2025

value.unit: percent of new US startups with a solo founder

claims.text: The top 100 AI companies on Stripe reached $1 million in annualised revenue in a median of 11.5 months.
claims.quote: a median of 11.5 months

claims.text: Bessemer puts the fastest AI companies at $1.13 million of recurring revenue per employee, four to five times a typical software company.
claims.quote: $1.13 million of recurring revenue per employee

value.unit: million USD recurring revenue per employee

claims.text: In a study of 2.7 million US founders, the mean age at founding for the 1-in-1,000 fastest growing new ventures is 45.0.
claims.quote: The mean age at founding for the 1-in-1,000 fastest growing new ventures is 45.0

value.unit: mean founding age of the fastest-growing US ventures

claims.text: Founders with three or more years in the same industry reached top-tier growth at twice the rate of those with none.
claims.quote: Founders with three or more years in the same industry reached top-tier growth at twice the rate of those with none.

value.unit: times the rate of top-tier growth with three or more years in the industry

claims.text: What held the experts back was not knowledge but access to capital, engineers and the long build before anything could be shown, which is the part that got cheap.
claims.quote: What held the experts back was not knowledge. It was access

claims.text: The owner's own example is security: sgit.ai and RiskMandate use his security knowledge, the agents write most of the code, and SG/Send alone has 4,476 commits.
claims.quote: The agents write most of the code, and SG/Send alone has 4,476 commits

claims.text: Chinmay Gupte, a consultant knee surgeon in London, is building OmKneeHealth, a clinically led platform dedicated exclusively to knee health, with My Knee Score.
claims.quote: a clinically led platform dedicated exclusively to knee health

claims.text: Kate Curtis-Evans founded Audio Genius, legal transcription and workflow management built by a transcriber for transcription professionals.
claims.quote: Built by a Transcriber, for Transcription Professionals

claims.text: In Equidam's data European companies raise at higher revenue and lower valuations than US ones, a median pre-money of $6.54 million against $14.64 million, with targets 46% smaller.
claims.quote: at median pre-money valuations of $6.54 million against $14.64 million, with funding targets 46% smaller

value.unit: million USD median pre-money valuation, Europe against the US

claims.text: The Startup Genome study of about 3,200 high-growth internet startups found 74% fail due to premature scaling, and investors invest 2 to 3 times more than necessary in discovery.
claims.quote: 74% of high growth internet startups fail due to premature scaling

value.unit: percent of high-growth internet startups failing from premature scaling

claims.text: European investors' scepticism is exactly what this generation needs, because getting money too soon is one of the worst things that can happen to a startup.
claims.quote: I think that scepticism is exactly what this generation needs

claims.text: Atomico's 2025 report finds European companies are just as capital efficient as their US counterparts; the gap is in the size of the money, not the skill.
claims.quote: European companies are just as capital efficient as their US counterparts

claims.text: Europe is where open source has a policy behind it: the Commission's June 2026 sovereignty package includes an open source strategy, and Mistral 3 was released under Apache 2.0.
claims.quote: All models are released under the Apache 2.0 license.

claims.text: Dealroom found impact took 15% of European VC funding in 2025, about twice North America's 7%.
claims.quote: Impact took 15% of European VC funding in 2025

value.unit: percent of European VC funding to impact

claims.text: The Draghi report says the EU's share of global VC funds raised is 5% against 52% in the US, and close to 30% of European unicorns moved their headquarters abroad.
claims.quote: The share of global VC funds raised in the EU is just 5%, compared to 52% in the US

value.unit: percent of global VC funds raised, EU against US

claims.text: The article does not claim outsiders are finished; new blood still matters, and the claim is that experts can now start too.
claims.quote: Not that outsiders are finished.

claims.text: The AI growth figures are the fastest companies, not the typical, and some, like Y Combinator's, are the promoter's own.
claims.quote: The AI growth figures are the fastest, not the typical.

claims.text: The Europe and US comparison is weakly evidenced: one vendor's aggregated data, and no clean Series A study was found.
claims.quote: The Europe and US comparison is weakly evidenced.

claims.text: No survey of software satisfaction was found; the friction figures stand in for it.
claims.quote: No survey of software satisfaction was found.

claims.text: Two of the three founders are people the owner helps; what is said about them is from their own public descriptions.
claims.quote: Two of the three founders are people I help.

claims.text: The article was updated on 15 October: Kate's surname, company and her own description were added after publication.
claims.quote: Kate's surname, company and her own description were added after publication.

claims.text: The owner has a stake: sgit.ai and RiskMandate are his.
claims.quote: sgit.ai and RiskMandate are mine.

claims.text: The article comes from a voice memo on 15 October 2026, and three research agents checked the sources the same day.
claims.quote: Three research agents checked the sources on 15 October 2026.
